issues.on_page: p4 Other Governmental Funds column Taxes 666,246; full PDF p27 Note L: 'the City abated $666,246 in property tax revenue under the tax increment/community redevelopment program'; p2 TIF program receipts 666,246
issues.issue: Split judged supported. The line's own fund column holds exactly 666,246, and Note L prints the same figure, to the dollar, as property tax revenue (TIF increment). Two cautions, logged for the record: (1) Note A (full PDF p19, report p17) defines TIF revenues as 'ad valorem property taxes and monies received from redevelopment companies'. Note L's exact 666,246 attributes the whole Taxes amount to property tax, and the column's non-tax TIF money (charges 158,323, grants 253,601) is printed on separate lines. (2) The Statement of Activities (p2) shows the 666,246 as TIF program receipts (charges for services), not as a general-receipts tax, and Note L says TIF transactions are reported 'within the General Fund' while p4 shows them under Other Governmental Funds. That is a wording inconsistency in the report, not in the amount. The remaining pieces, taxes (unlabeled) 2,909,007 (General 2,091,800 + Debt Service 817,207) and sales tax 898,749 (City Sales Tax column), add with this one to exactly 4,474,002.

That makes this keno/lottery, which has its own category. The governmental receipts line receipts[4] (2,026,979) is about 52% keno money for the same reason.

Note A says Streets program receipts are highway allocation and incentive payments, reimbursements and labor/materials sold, and p2 Streets operating grants is 150,262. This is more likely intergovernmental/state aid than donations.
This is Street Fund state money, which Note A describes as highway allocation, so detail_category highway allocation is likely.
